findings.trigger: Docker creates daemon-owned container before CLI failure/timeout
findings.fix: Cleanup ownership now begins before launch and final forced removal targets the unique owned name

findings.trigger: SDKROOT selects a different SDK in unqualified build lookup than explicit macosx preflight
findings.requested_fix: Use verified host.json SDK path, pass it explicitly to libcxx and constrain compiler selection
findings.fix: Use verified host.json macOS SDK and developer path, clear inherited DEVELOPER_DIR/SDK/compiler/header overrides before doctor, pass explicit SDK to each source builder including libc++, and select CC/CXX with explicit macosx lookup

findings.trigger: SIGTERM/Actions deadline bypasses default Python finally and leaves daemon workload
findings.requested_fix: Handle termination with bounded process-group/container cleanup or provide named-container always cleanup
findings.fix: SIGINT/SIGTERM raises a handled failure, active child process group receives bounded TERM/KILL cleanup, atomic result.json records unique container ownership, and workflow always performs named forced cleanup
